scope: Static literal-expression and supplied-formula checks; no driving claim or preset promotion.
limitations: Twenty-four fresh synthetic geometries in twelve mirrored pairs and repeated conditions are not independent driving trials.

Only question text changes within each block. Literal substitution and explicit multiplication wording change together, so a gain does not isolate either clause or identify an internal reasoning mechanism.
Formula state retains the full observation and duplicate raw named coordinates. Denominator state contains only x and y, so component and formula tasks are not matched context contrasts.
The host substitutes only raw observed numbers into a prescribed expression; it does not calculate or submit a numerator, denominator, angle, target or recommended control.
Coarse wheel answers cannot prove exact trigonometric execution. A supplied policy's label is not an optimal driving action and static accuracy cannot qualify driving.
Heading-sign mismatch groups can differ in target magnitude; subgroup scores do not isolate a sign-conflict effect.
Endpoint errors count as incorrect in attempted accuracy; planned coverage and unrun cases remain separate.
recommendation: Retain damped as live baseline and original application default. Literal wording improves static scores but fails the overall/per-magnitude gate; no native-menu continuation or live promotion.

interpretation: The literal question raises denominator accuracy23/48 to35/48. Choices matching x*x+y decline21 to8, while x=15 substitution distractors rise4 to5. This is a combined wording/literal-expression contrast, not an identified variable-binding or internal-arithmetic mechanism.

Formula accuracy rises22/48 to29/48. Every one of the12 wrong-to-correct pairs is a straight target; all5 correct-to-wrong pairs are full targets. Moderate targets remain16/16. The net gain combines improved zero selection and lost full-magnitude selection.
Literal formula choices are35 moderate and13 straight, with no full wheel choice. All16 required full targets select moderate with correct raw-y sign. Baseline chooses42moderate,5full and1straight.

Only one baseline nonzero formula choice has the opposite raw-y sign: literal-00-a repetition1 is a straight target and chooses-0.06 with the current-road-heading sign. All35 nonzero literal choices follow raw-y sign. Correct sign does not establish correct magnitude or exact calculation.

For every selected wrong denominator in both prompts (25 baseline and13 literal), substituting that value with an otherwise correct numerator preserves the coarse formula wheel label on this new bank. The listed isolated denominator confusions alone are therefore insufficient, under this offline hypothetical calculation, to reproduce the separate formula-label errors. This does not establish which denominator or computation occurred inside formula answers.

The literal formula fails the declared continuation gate:29/48 is below90%, and full-target accuracy0/16 is below85%. The observed +7/48 net formula gain exceeds10points but is insufficient. Denominator gains do not govern this gate; no native-menu continuation is triggered.

Per-case two-repeat scores and mirrored fixtures remain correlated; counts are descriptive, not independent sample sizes or evidence of reliable driving. Improved isolated arithmetic and separate formula answers cannot establish denominator errors as a cause of formula outcomes.
